data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L5 ~ Persistent Image
data.name: Persistent Image
data.description: This spell functions like silent image, except that the figment includes visual, auditory, olfactory, and thermal components, and the figment follows a script determined by you. The figment follows that script without your having to concentrate on it. The illusion can include intelligible speech if you wish.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
